race.description: Ladbrokes Racing Extras In Multi Hcp (Rs1ly)
race.comment: Open race to close out the card. The well-related AMUSEANTES (16) (half to G1 winner Startantes) returned in fine fashion with a solid Doomben victory and winning hoop Marshall retains the mount. Should get a soft run from the inside alley and can go back-to-back to start the campaign. HELL (3) will strip fitter third-up from the break and gets the reliable Gollan/Lang combination. Can feature from the favourable draw. CASPERNOVA (5) is a two-time winner over this course and distance and shouldn't be underestimated. SHE'S EXOTIC (8) next in line out of the Dunn yard. Back to Eagle Farm can be a help for her. Lone run here was good.
